title: Evaluation of the binding affinity of E3 ubiquitin ligase ligands by cellular target engagement and in-cell ELISA assay
protocol: Resuspend MM1S cells thoroughly using a serological pipette or alternative method.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL conical tube and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at room temperature ranging from 20°C to 23°C.
Remove culture medium and resuspend cells in cell culture medium thoroughly.
Take the cell solution for cell counting using either a hemocytometer or an automated cell counting instrument.
Dilute the cell solution to 5 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Evenly distribute 100 μL of diluted cell solution to each well of a 96-well plate, resulting in 5 × 10^4 cells per well using a multiple-channel pipette or alternative method.
Seed cells in an incubator for 12–18 h.
Directly dilute the ligand, degrader, and vehicle solutions in cell culture medium.
Prepare dilution by adding concentrated dose solution to vehicle solution if further dilutions are needed.
Add 1 μL of 10 mM pomalidomide stock into 555.6 μL cell culture medium as highest dose solution.
Add 2 μL DMSO into 1,111.1 μL cell culture medium as vehicle solution.
Make a 1:3 dilution by adding 100 μL of highest dose solution to 200 μL vehicle solution.
Incubate cells for 1 h at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Dose cells with 25 μL of 600 nM degrader WH181 or vehicle in culture medium.
Redistribute the cells evenly by gently vortexing the culture plate.
Incubate the cells for 6 h at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Spin down the cell culture plate at over 1,000 × g for 3 min.
Add 150 μL of fixation solution (2×) to each well without removing cell culture medium.
Add fixation solution slowly and gently to the wall of the plate well.
Incubate the plate at room temperature (20°C–23°C) for 15 minutes with shaking at 500 rpm for 10 minutes, followed by 5 minutes without shaking.
Remove the fixation mixture by vacuum.
Add 300 μL washing buffer.
Quickly remove the washing buffer by vacuum.
Add 300 μL washing buffer.
Incubate plate at room temperature (20°C–23°C) for at least 3 min.
Remove washing buffer and repeat washing step one more time.
Add 100 μL permeabilization solution.
Incubate plate at room temperature (20°C–23°C) for 10 min.
Remove permeabilization solution by vacuum.
Rinse once and wash once with washing buffer.
Add 100 μL quenching solution.
Incubate plate at room temperature (20°C–23°C) for 20 min.
Remove quenching solution by vacuum.
Rinse once and wash once with washing buffer.
Add 100 μL antibody buffer 1 without antibodies.
Incubate plate, without shaking, overnight (16–18 h) at 4°C.
Alternatives: The incubation can be done for 1 h at room temperature (20°C–23°C).
Add antibody buffer 1 to at least two “vehicle only” wells as background control.
Incubate the plate with primary antibody solution for 2 hours at room temperature (20°C–23°C).
Remove primary antibody solution by vacuum.
Rinse once and wash three times with washing buffer.
Incubate the plate with secondary antibody solution for 1 hour at room temperature (20°C–23°C).
Remove secondary antibody solution from each well by vacuum.
Rinse once and wash four times with washing buffer.
Add 100 μL TMB substrate mixture to each well immediately before use.
Incubate the plate in the dark for 20 minutes at room temperature (20°C–23°C).
Add 50 μL stop solution to each well.
Incubate plate for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–23°C).
Read optical density (OD) at 450 nm and 540 nm (background) of each well by plate reader.
Remove TMB reaction mixture by vacuum.
Rinse once and wash three times with washing buffer.
Add 50 μL staining solution to each well.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–23°C).
Remove staining solution by vacuum.
Rinse once with washing buffer.
Wash four times with washing buffer, using reduced volume (~100 μL) for the first two washes to efficiently remove excess staining reagent from well walls.
Add 100 μL equilibrating solution.
Remove equilibrating solution by vacuum.
Add 100 μL solubilization solution.
Incubate plate for 10 min at room temperature (20°C–23°C).
Read OD at 595 nm and 750 nm (background) of each well by plate reader.
Reduce the cell number to 2 × 10^4 cells per well in a 96-well plate for target engagement assay in Jurkat cell line.
Carefully redistribute the cells after addition of compounds solution.
Increase the cell number to 7 × 10^4 cells per well in a 96-well plate for IKZF1 measurement in MM1S cell line.
Decrease antibody ratio to 1:2,000 when preparing primary antibody solution for IKZF3 measurement in MM1S cell line.
Add 25 μL 5× dose medium containing E3 ligands or degraders instead of sequential addition for both IKZF1 and IKZF3 measurements.
Reduce the number of MCF-7 cells to 5 × 10³ cells per well in a 96-well plate.
Extend the treatment time of degrader(s) to 12 hours.
Exclude the spin down step before fixation.
Remove the medium containing compounds.
Add 1× fixation solution (4% formaldehyde) for fixation.
